lines.text: Your best friends sent hearts. The gym guy sent the job.
lines.say: Your best friends sent hearts. [short pause] The gym guy... sent the job.
lines.tone: flat, almost amused, like you are letting the listener in on something

lines.text: Rewind. You had the best crew alive. Ride or die since high school.
lines.say: Rewind. You had the best crew alive. Ride or die, since high school.
[short pause] Then you get laid off.

lines.text: You tell the group chat. Hearts. Prayers. Zero leads.
lines.say: You tell the group chat. Hearts. Prayers. [short pause] Zero leads.
lines.tone: flat, tired, each word its own beat

lines.text: Three months. Two hundred applications. Nothing.
lines.say: Three months. Two hundred applications. [sighs] Nothing.
lines.tone: flat, tired, each word its own beat

lines.text: Then a guy from the gym. You've talked twice. He sends you a link.
lines.say: Then... a guy from the gym. You've talked twice. He sends you a link.
lines.tone: curious, brightening, slower on the first word

lines.text: Two weeks later, you're hired. More money than before.

lines.tone: fired up, preacher stepping up to the pulpit
fired up, preacher stepping up to the pulpit

lines.text: Your boys know the same people you know. They hear about the same jobs.
lines.tone: explaining, steady, leaning on the word same

lines.text: The guy you barely know lives in a different world. He sees doors you can't.
lines.say: The guy you barely know? Lives in a different world. He sees doors you can't.
lines.tone: explaining, steady, a little lift on different world

lines.text: A study of 282 workers. The ones hired through a contact? Only one in six saw that person often.
lines.say: A study of two hundred eighty two workers. The ones hired through a contact? [short pause] Only one in six saw that person often.
lines.tone: matter of fact, like reading evidence

lines.text: LinkedIn tested twenty million people. The best ties for a new job? Not distant contacts. Not best friends. The people in between.
lines.say: LinkedIn tested twenty million people. The best ties for a new job? Not distant contacts. Not best friends. [short pause] The people in between.
lines.tone: matter of fact, like reading evidence

lines.text: So keep your boys. But text the guy from the gym.
lines.say: So keep your boys. [short pause] But text the guy from the gym.

lines.text: Strong ties produce belonging. Weak ties produce mobility.
